# Sermon Steward

> Sermon Steward takes a church's Sunday sermon and turns it into material the church can use through the week and for years to come: a clean transcript, a sermon page with the thesis and structure, discussion questions, daily devotional prompts, and a searchable archive by scripture, series, topic, and doctrine. It is built by pastors, for pastors, and run by Pastor Chris Oswald of Providence Community Church, Lenexa, Kansas.

Sermons belong to their churches and preachers; each sermon page links back to its church.

## Start here
- [Home](https://sermonsteward.com/): what Sermon Steward is and how it works, with pricing as published on the page
- [How it works](https://sermonsteward.com/how-it-works/): from Sunday recording to published sermon pages
- [Samples](https://sermonsteward.com/samples.html): example stewarded sermons
- [Try one sermon](https://try.sermonsteward.com/): free one-sermon try
- Contact: chris@sovgracekc.org

## The Guild Hall
- [Guild Hall](https://sermonsteward.com/hall/): a free gallery of historic and contemporary preachers (Spurgeon, Lloyd-Jones, Stott, Keller, Piper, and others), each read the same way: rhetorical fingerprint, structure, and craft
- [The Shepherd's Guild](https://theshepherdsguild.com/): the Guild's own site

## Church sermon archives
- [Providence Community Church, Lenexa, KS](https://sermonsteward.com/ProvidenceLenexa/): church page; [all sermons](https://sermonsteward.com/ProvidenceLenexa/sermons/)
- [Cross of Grace Church, El Paso, TX](https://sermonsteward.com/CoGElPaso/): church page; [all sermons](https://sermonsteward.com/CoGElPaso/sermons/)
